verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API that offers full dashboard parity: anything you can do in the dashboard can be done through it, including creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users. A separate public Flags API uses environment keys, and the official CLI (with raw API access) and MCP server are built on the same API, so programmatic driving is clearly first-party. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at any of the candidate paths, which limits machine-readable discovery but does not contradict the API's existence. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, documented Admin API authentication details, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This is the API you use to programmatically manage your Flagsmith projects. Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
Purpose: Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
The CLI covers flags, segments, features, organisations, projects, environments, SDK-style flag evaluation, and raw API access.
